chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'id al-'Askari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Hamdan al-Qushayri narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn 'Isa al-Kilabi narrated to us. He said: Musa ibn Isma'il ibn Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated to us in the year 205 AH. He said: My father narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Whoever recites after the Friday prayer the Opening of the Book once and "Say: He is Allah, the One" seven times, and the Opening of the Book once and "Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak" seven times, and the Opening of the Book once and "Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind" seven times, no calamity will befall him and no trial will afflict him until the next Friday.

And if he says: "O Allah, make me from the people of Paradise, which is filled with blessings and built by angels, with our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah bless him and his family) and our father Ibrahim (peace be upon him)," Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will gather him with Muhammad and Ibrahim in the Abode of Peace.
May the blessings of Allah be upon Muhammad and Ibrahim and their pure families.

key_terms.دار السلام: The Abode of Peace, a name for Paradise (Jannah)
key_terms.دبر صلاة الجمعة: After the Friday prayer -- the time immediately following the congregational prayer
key_terms.فاتحة الكتاب: The Opening of the Book (Surah al-Fatiha), the first chapter of the Quran
key_terms.قل هو الله أحد: Say: He is Allah, the One (Surah al-Ikhlas, Chapter 112)

ai.seo_question: What should one recite after Friday prayer for protection from calamity according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) prescribed a specific recitation practice after Friday prayer: reciting Surah al-Fatiha with each of Surah al-Ikhlas, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah al-Nas seven times each, promising protection from calamity and trial for the entire week. Additionally, he taught a supplication asking to be among the people of Paradise alongside the Prophet Muhammad and Prophet Ibrahim (AS), promising divine reunion with both prophets in the Abode of Peace. This hadith was transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt chain of Imams going back to Imam Ali (AS).

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Sa`id al-`Askari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Hamdan al-Qushayri narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Isa al-Kilabi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. Isma`il b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to me in 205 AH. He said: My father narrated to me from his father from his grandfather Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali b. Abi Talib (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Whoever recites, after the Friday prayer, the Fatiha once, qul huwallahu ahad seven times, the Fatiha once, qul a`uthu bi rabb al-falaq seven times, the Fatiha once, and qul a`uthu bi rabb al-nas seven times will not be afflicted with a calamity or a temptation until the next Friday.

If he says: “O Allah! Make me from the people of Paradise, which is filled with blessing and is built by angels, with our Prophet Muhammad (s), and our father Ibrahim (as). (Allahumma ja`alni min ahl al-jannati lati hushuha baraka wa `ammaraha mala’ika ma` nabiyyina Muhammadan salla llahu `alayhi wa aalih wa abina Ibrahim `alayhis salam)”, Allah will make him among Muhammad and Ibrahim in the Abode of Peace
– may the blessings of Allah be upon Muhammad and Ibrahim and their pure families.
